text: Apparel items on Flipkart are eligible for return within 7 days of delivery.
The item must be unused with all original tags and packaging intact.
Size and fit issues are accepted as valid return reasons for apparel.
Returns requested after the 7-day window are automatically declined by the system.
Footwear purchased on Flipkart can be returned within 7 days of delivery.
Shoes must be unworn, show no signs of outdoor use, and be returned in the original box with all accessories.
Fit and comfort complaints are accepted as valid reasons within this window.
Footwear returned after 7 days, or showing wear on the sole, will not be accepted.
Electronics carry a 10-day window from delivery, but it covers replacement for a genuine functional defect only, not a change of mind.
A defective unit is swapped for an identical new unit after a quality check confirms the fault.
Electronics that power on and function normally cannot be returned simply because the buyer no longer wants them.
Sealed accessories and original packaging must be returned along with the unit.
Home and kitchen products are eligible for return within 7 days of delivery.
Items must be unused and returned with the original packaging, manuals, and any bundled accessories.
Products that have been assembled, installed, or show signs of use are not eligible.
Fragile items must be repacked exactly as received to qualify for pickup.
Beauty and personal care products, including lipstick and other cosmetics, are non-returnable on hygiene grounds once delivered.
The only exceptions are items that arrive damaged, expired, or different from what was ordered.
In those exception cases, a replacement or refund is issued after photo verification.
Opened cosmetic products cannot be returned for change-of-mind reasons.
For cash-on-delivery orders, refunds are issued as a bank transfer since there is no source payment instrument to credit back.
The refund is initiated only after reverse pickup is completed and the returned item passes a quality check.
Once initiated, the amount reaches the customer's bank account within 5-7 business days.
Customers must share valid bank account details to receive a COD refund.
Orders paid by debit or credit card are refunded to the same source card once the returned item clears quality check after reverse pickup.
The bank typically credits the amount within 3-5 business days of the refund being initiated.
Actual crediting time can vary slightly by issuing bank.
No new bank details are required since the refund goes back to the original card.
Orders paid via UPI are refunded to the originating UPI ID within 24-48 hours of the refund being initiated after quality check.
Wallet payments are refunded almost instantly, usually crediting the wallet balance within minutes.
Both methods are faster than card or COD refunds because they settle through real-time payment rails.
Customers can track either refund from the order details page.
Orders shipped to metro cities such as Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Chennai are typically delivered within 2-4 days of dispatch.
Standard shipping is used for most metro pincodes with same-day or next-day dispatch from the nearest warehouse.
Express-eligible items in metro areas may arrive even faster.
Delays beyond 4 days in a metro pincode should be reported to support.

doc_title: Delivery SLA — Non-Metro and Remote Pincodes
text: Non-metro towns generally see delivery within 4-8 days of dispatch, depending on distance from the nearest hub.

doc_title: Delivery SLA — Non-Metro and Remote Pincodes
text: Remote or difficult-to-access pincodes can take up to 10 days because couriers route through additional local transfer points.

doc_title: Delivery SLA — Non-Metro and Remote Pincodes
text: Weather and regional logistics disruptions can add extra days beyond these estimates.

doc_title: Delivery SLA — Non-Metro and Remote Pincodes
text: Customers in remote pincodes are shown the estimated delivery date at checkout before placing the order.

Reverse pickup is offered when the delivery pincode is serviceable by a courier partner, the return is requested within the applicable return window, and the item is in its original, unused condition.
If reverse pickup is not serviceable at a pincode, the customer is asked to self-ship the item instead.
Eligibility is checked automatically the moment a return is raised against an order.

doc_title: Reverse Pickup Scheduling and Failed Attempts
text: Once a return is approved, the courier partner schedules reverse pickup and makes up to 3 attempts to collect the item from the customer's address.

doc_title: Reverse Pickup Scheduling and Failed Attempts
text: If all 3 attempts fail, usually because the customer was unavailable, the system automatically switches to a self-ship fallback with a prepaid shipping label.

doc_title: Reverse Pickup Scheduling and Failed Attempts
text: Customers are notified by SMS and app notification before each pickup attempt.

doc_title: Reverse Pickup Scheduling and Failed Attempts
text: Failing to hand over the item within the retry window can cause the return to be cancelled.
Exchanges are available only for apparel and footwear, and only for a different size or color of the same product.
Only one exchange is permitted per order line item, after which any further change must go through the standard return process.
The replacement item ships only after the original item is picked up or handed over for reverse pickup.
Exchange requests follow the same 7-day window as the category's return policy.
Items that arrive physically damaged or with a manufacturing defect must be reported within 48 hours of delivery.
Customers are asked to provide unboxing photos or a video showing the damage as evidence for the claim.
Once verified, a free reverse pickup is arranged and a replacement or full refund is issued without deducting any fee.
Claims raised after the 48-hour window are handled under the standard category return policy instead.
Every refund is assigned a reference ID that customers can use to track its status from the order details page.
The status moves through initiated, processed, and credited stages, each timestamped for visibility.
If a refund is not credited within the SLA stated for its payment method, the customer can escalate the reference ID to a human support agent.
Escalated cases are reviewed within 2 business days of being raised.
